name: code-review
description: Three-step code review: locate relevant files in the repo, propose a dry-run refactor patch, then hand off to a human for final review and apply. Requires AGENT_CODEGEN_TOOLS=1 on the server.

steps.title: Locate relevant files in the indexed repo
Manual review — approve or request changes

payload.prompt: Review the proposed patch returned by propose_patch. This recipe intentionally stops short of applying the patch. To apply, call POST /refactor/plans/:id/apply with {"dryRun": false, "writeToDisk": true} AND ensure WORKSPACE_FILE_TOOLS=1 is set on the server.
